instance_description:
Setting: Personal health maintenance for a 2026 urban apartment routine, centered on one adult balancing a steady job, local appointments, home routines, and community fitness.
Scope: Covers scheduling preparation, saved professional instructions, symptom-neutral wellbeing tracking, nutrition planning, mobility-friendly exercise, sleep habits, accessibility supports, and household health supplies.
Resources: Empty reusable SQLite tables can store personal preferences, care contacts, and routine records; blank TXT files can later hold instructions, checklists, and summaries.
Exclusions: No diagnosis, treatment choice, medication dosage changes, emergency triage, insurance disputes, or clinical judgment beyond organizing existing information.
personal_description:
Identity: Arden Mireille Sutter is a 39-year-old public library accessibility coordinator living alone in Portland, Oregon, throughout 2026.
Responsibilities: Arden manages personal appointments, routine exercise, meal planning, sleep hygiene, home supplies, accessibility equipment upkeep, and preparation for nonurgent health visits.
Authority: Arden may organize records, set reminders, compare schedules, follow saved clinician or trainer guidance, and decide everyday logistics within established plans.
Restrictions: Arden does not ask the agent to diagnose conditions, choose treatments, alter prescribed doses, interpret urgent symptoms, or contact providers without explicit scenario permission.
